audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (25 files in inventory). EPCCO is Eastern Province Cement Company (confirmed on every cover).
audit.method: All 25 files opened (cover or statements). The 18 statement filings had BS, IS and CF read: image-statement files (FY2022-FY2025, Q1 2022-9M 2023, Q1 2024) rendered and read by eye; text-layer interims (H1 2024 onward except Q1 2024) read from the text layer via tools/rows.py, with totals cross-checked by identities. Seven annual reports identified from rendered covers only. tools/check_transcripts.py passes for transcripts/3080.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. BS totals, income statement through net profit and EPS, and cash flow (CFO/CFI/CFF/net change/opening/closing cash) transcribed for FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 and every interim Q1 2022 to H1 2026 (18 filings; image statements rendered and read, text-layer filings read from the text layer without render). Every identity passes (BS equation, CF sum and roll, gross profit, 18 revenue and net-income quarter-sum chains). 78 cross-filing differences declared with both values: FY2023 restated in the FY2024 file (Note 39: revenue 984,576 vs 995,666, net profit 197,627 vs 196,492, total assets 2,846,531 vs 2,844,109); FY2021 restated in the FY2022 file (Note 37); 2022 interims restated in 2023 filings (Note 20: e.g. Q1 2022 net profit 28,986 vs 26,321); 2024 interims reclassified in 2025 filings (Q1 2024 net profit 67,864 vs 79,005, H1 2024 128,368 vs 134,385, 9M 2024 169,522 vs 185,089); FY2022 CFI -129,890 vs -259,890 because a 130,000 Murabaha deposit moved from financing to investing. The pipeline must choose which vintage is final; this audit declares them.
